title: Synthesis 13: bodies rearrange what they hold but do not replace it (crawler repair at 66% size, size set by conserved totals), and who makes a wall decides whether it counts (the nematic ring is the bath's; the FCH gate localizes beyond diffusion)
summary: Since 20:55: the wave-pinning crawler's front repair is established as IRM (beyond diffusion), and its audit shows the cell never regains lost matter because size is set by the conserved protein total. The nematic fuel-cell rods are held as SID, and their audit shows the bath makes ~70% of the ring's surfactant; a rod-made ring forms but does not gate. b42-metabolic is held as SIBDH, with selection real but acting through founders. CIPS SIE (E not by construction) is established with its local cut and its no-size-cap negative. Next: a conserved-enzyme division route for CIPS (C:metabolic-cell), a self-made boundary and a fed protein source for the crawler (C:motile-repair), and per-individual metabolism tests by default.
